category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, increase causal pooled-state weight from 0.20 to 0.23 while retaining the three-interaction half-life. This tests slightly broader interest retention while preserving padding exclusion, causal histories, final-real-position inference, GRU topology, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer. Synchronize metadata and predictor validation.

response.change_summary: Increase causal pooling contribution to 23% and synchronize checkpoint metadata with the embedded predictor. Preserve one GRU4Rec model per dataset and existing training limits.
